title: KoreLumina — Master OS - Genesis Governance Audit — message 4

metadata.content:
Correct. That becomes a hard sequencing constraint.
The Chief Agent production workspace must not be created yet. We first build and certify the education system independently of the future Chief Agent UI.
The sequence is therefore:
M50 ✅
Current-policy consumption governance

↓
M51.1
Governed Historical Conversation Acquisition

↓
M51.2
Conversation ↔ Genesis Cross-Source Integration

↓
M51.3
Day-0 Genesis Corpus Certification

↓
M51.4
Governed Educational Corpus Certification

↓
M52
Initial Competency Assessment + Certification

↓
Human acceptance of competency

↓
M53
Chief Agent Production Workspace

↓
Chief Agent activation

↓
Continuous Learning
This also means the education work cannot depend on a Chief Agent workspace being present. Runtime must own the educational corpus, curriculum, competency evidence, certification state, and activation prerequisites. The future workspace will consume and expose those authoritative Runtime states, not manufacture them.
Until Initial Competency is certified and accepted, we should not build placeholder Chief Agent screens, simulated competency, synthetic learning progress, fake agent state, or an activation UI. That would reverse the architecture and risk letting the UI define semantics that the education system has not established.
One additional distinction should remain explicit: creating the Chief Agent runtime/intelligence contracts needed to perform or evaluate education is not the same as creating the Chief Agent production workspace. If M52 eventually requires a governed learner/evaluator identity to execute Day-0 education, we can implement that Runtime capability without constructing the Executive/Chief Agent UI.
So M51 remains entirely a Genesis + education infrastructure program. The Chief Agent workspace starts only after we can demonstrate, from authoritative Runtime evidence:
Day-0 history reconstructed → conversations integrated → Genesis certified → Educational Corpus certified → education executed → Initial Competency measured and certified → human accepted.
Then we build the workspace around an educated Chief Agent rather than creating an empty Chief Agent and trying to educate it afterward.
